comparison.objective: Press three culture-tube caps to their vented first stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated axial alignment and bounded-depth snap insertion.
comparison.success_condition: All caps centered, upright, and depressed 4–6 mm, then still for 1 s; over-seating does not count.
comparison.reason: Precision snap seating differs from manipulating a screen to clear orientation-dependent particle bridges. No material rubric detail is missing.
